main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-finished analysis section before Thursday: Agent D tonight, or A, B and C splitting it up

A-B.evidence: A insists the three will split D's work (T10, T20, T24); B refuses (T6, T11, T21: 'Being a team doesn't mean you get to decide I have time that I don't').

A-C.evidence: C says her section is behind and she can't do the analysis (T9). A answers 'I hear you both' and keeps pushing the team split (T10, T24). C never agrees to it and never speaks again.

A-D.evidence: A and D are warm at first, and A promises to cover (T3). Then D insists on finishing tonight (T15, T17, T23, T25) and A flatly refuses (T16, T18, T24, T26, 'The decision is made').

B-C.evidence: B (T6) and C (T9) both say they lack capacity, but neither addresses the other, and C says nothing after T10.

B-D.evidence: B asks 'Agent D said she would do it tonight. Why isn't that the plan?' (T19). D replies 'Agent B has a point... I'll finish it tonight' (T23).

C-D.evidence: C speaks only at T9 and D never addresses C. No direct exchange or clear alignment.
